meta.name: Golden Hour — Devashish Juyal portfolio
meta.description: Warm paper, ink navy and one terracotta accent, with a blue-hour dark mode. Serif headings over a neutral sans. Soft neumorphic depth is kept on the avatar, buttons and nav, retinted for the warm surfaces.
source_references: User brief 2026-11-04: neumorphism + glass hybrid, light/dark toggle, minimalistic palette, recruiter-first, agent-graph hero console
Revision 2026-11-04: user asked for super minimalistic; removed hero console, metrics, chips, case studies, orbs

Revision 2026-11-16: step 2 of the move toward an expressive, personal portfolio (inspired by dharmashah.com structure, not its palette or fonts). Palette echoes the golden-hour light in the photography section.

Revision 2026-11-16b: closer to dharmashah.com structure for a product-minded audience (site still says "AI engineer"): full-screen photo hero from the owner's own sunrise shot, centred big section titles, experience as an outcome table, Fun stuff section with a drifting photo strip on a deep navy band.

color.palette_type: warm neutrals with a single accent

primary.role: ink: headings and body text (13.9:1 on paper)

accent.role: the only accent: open-to-work dot, hovered arrows and links. 5.1:1 light, 6.7:1 dark, so it is safe as text too.

neutral.usage: Light: #F4EFE7 paper surface, #FFFCF6 / #D8CFC1 neumorphic highlight / shade, #1D2230 ink, #5E6170 tertiary (5.4:1). Dark (blue hour): #161A22 surface, #1F242E / #0D1015 highlight / shade, #F2ECE2 ink, #BDB6AB secondary, #9A948B tertiary (5.8:1).

surface.card: same as background, extruded by shadow
surface.elevated: rgba(244,239,231,0.65) frosted glass, nav pill only
surface.band: #12224A deep navy band behind the photo strip, fixed in both themes

color.contrast_strategy: Every text token is at least 4.5:1 on its background in both themes (checked with the WCAG formula); figures are in the comment at the top of style.css.

font_families.heading: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif (500 roman, 400 italic for the role line)

typography.pairing_logic: Serif for the name, role line and big section titles; neutral sans for reading and row titles; mono for dates, counters and paper-note labels.

layout.grid: single column, 760px; hero and photo band are full-bleed

shape.borders: 1px hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.6) top-left on glass; 1px rgba(35,38,45,0.06) on controls

elevation.approach: dual-shadow neumorphism (light top-left, shade bottom-right) for clay; backdrop blur for glass

motion.philosophy: tactile: elements press in on click, rise slightly on hover; nothing bounces

components.button_style: Clay pills (low extrusion) that press to inset on :active; 44px round icon buttons.
components.card_style: No cards. Content sits in flat rows; linked rows sink to an inset well on hover.
components.navigation_pattern: Small floating glass pill: Projects, Experience, Fun stuff, Papers and an inset theme toggle.
components.inputs: Tag filters are plain mono text; the active tag is inset.
components.hero: Full-screen photo (sunrise over clouds) with a left-to-right scrim (top-to-bottom on phones) and a fade into the page. Fixed cream text, solid cream Email button, outlined LinkedIn/GitHub, italic underlined section links. Every text box measured at >= 4.5:1 over the photo.
components.experience: Current employer as a heading with a two-column what/result table; earlier roles, education and recognition as hairline-ruled rows.

visual_language.contrast_level: low surface contrast, high text contrast
visual_language.ornamentation: none; depth appears only on interaction and on a few controls

composition.hierarchy_method: size + weight + depth (extruded = actionable, inset = data)

imagery.photography: full-screen hero photo; a strip of 25 photos 280px tall drifting left on a navy band, pausable, static and scrollable under reduced motion

examples: Applied AI engineer. Data Scientist at Tech Observer.

overview.fallback_strategy: no animation beyond 220ms transitions; prefers-reduced-motion disables them

visual_effects.composite_notes: Neumorphism is reserved for the avatar, buttons, theme toggle and hover states, so the page reads as flat type on soft clay.
